name: Improvised armoured cartel truck ('monstruo')
armament: Rifles and belt-fed machine guns fired through ports in the hull
Roof turret or open ring with a .50 BMG rifle or machine gun (some vehicles)
protection: Real-world type: civilian heavy pickups or medium trucks (Ford F-series, Ram, Kenworth/International cab-overs) clad in welded steel plate, sometimes layered with gaps, with slit vision blocks and run-flat or caged tyres. Protection is uneven and seams are weak. Game: immune to small-calibre rounds like all vehicles; 7.62x54R and larger penetrate easily; every launcher in the game list penetrates; tyres, engine grille and vision slits are weak points.
visual_notes: Generic inspired-by type, not a specific photographed vehicle
Base: a full-size crew-cab pickup or a 2-axle medium truck, entirely boxed in flat welded steel plates
Angular slab sides with rows of small square firing ports; narrow slits replacing the windscreen
Wedge-shaped front plate or ram bar over the grille; plates hanging low over the wheels
Roof hatch or box turret on some; fictional unit initials painted on the sides
Paint: matt black, olive or crude camouflage over bare welded seams and rust
variants: Armoured medium truck with troop box (large 'monstruo')
Turret truck with roof gun position
